slot: Your question, plus the daily report
summary: The S&P 500 recovered today, climbing to 7,660.95, up 0.39%, after yesterday's sharp drop driven by Middle East tensions. The VIX, which measures fear priced into the market, fell to 15.45, a sign investors calmed down. Gold rose 1.51% to 4,413.70 and oil held at 91.09, so energy inflation fears have not gone away. Friday's jobs report is the next big event and will set the tone for whether the Federal Reserve raises rates again.
